messages:
nora: Quick flag from user research: people are confused when the same action appears under two sidebar sections. Thinking compact IA: cluster by intent (Build / Deploy / Monitor) + keep resource-level links inside cluster. Thoughts?

ben: Sounds good. One ask: maintain stable canonical URLs for SEO/docs. We can't let IA changes break existing bookmarks.

alejandra: Agreed. Breadcrumbs should show both cluster and resource so folks learn the mapping: Projects > Deploy > Deploys > v3. Also add a shortlink pattern like /s/:short to satisfy support.

tim: Routing note: prefer query params for transient UI state (?panel=settings) and path segments for canonical identity (/projects/:pid/deploys/:did). That makes redirects simpler.

nora: Accessibility: when landing on a deep link, focus moves to H1 and announce the page. Also ensure collapse state of sidebar is stored in localStorage and reflected with aria-expanded.

ben: Implementation plan: 1) route map + redirects 2) breadcrumbs + focus flow 3) shortlink service 4) analytics mapping old->new.

alejandra: UX nit: on mobile collapse breadcrumbs to a single label with a back chevron. Also truncate long model names with tooltip on hover.

tim: Are we OK mapping old /models/:id -> /build/models/:id via 301 redirects? We'll need a redirect table and a shortlink lookup for customer-shared URLs.

nora: Yes. I'll draft migration notes and update help docs. Quick poll: react :thumbsup: to proceed, :eyes: if you want to review redirect list first.

ben: :thumbsup:
alejandra: :thumbsup:
tim: :eyes: will post redirect list by EOD
